words.context: Voiceless stops /k/ + /t/ — the classic "scratch no C, then AT then CAT" failure (voice-QA #463). The canonical hard case.

candidates.label: a — baseline (current live render)
candidates.mechanism: Break BEFORE each bare phoneme + whole line in <prosody rate="-12%">. The REJECTED production render (~37/40 FAIL, voice-QA #463).
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><prosody rate="-12%"><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="k">c</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="æ">a</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="t">t</phoneme><break time="450ms"/>cat</prosody></prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: b — break AFTER each phoneme
candidates.mechanism: Phoneme THEN break (stop releases into the pause) + same -12% rate wrap. Isolates the break-placement lever from the rate lever.
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><prosody rate="-12%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="k">c</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="æ">a</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="t">t</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><break time="450ms"/>cat</prosody></prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: c — no -12% rate (house rate), break-after
candidates.mechanism: No whole-line <prosody rate> — phonemes at the house rate (-10%), each followed by a break. Tests removing the rate lever the round-5 audition found over-articulates isolated onsets (86ca8c3t7).
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="k">c</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="æ">a</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="t">t</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><break time="450ms"/>cat</prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: d — letter-sounds envelope (300ms break-before, no rate wrap)
candidates.mechanism: Exact accepted letter-sounds shape: 300ms break BEFORE each phoneme, no whole-line rate wrap. Same break-before machinery the accepted letter-sounds tier uses, applied to PURE blend phonemes.
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><break time="300ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="k">c</phoneme><break time="300ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="æ">a</phoneme><break time="300ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="t">t</phoneme><break time="450ms"/>cat</prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: e — pitch-drop + volume-cut per phoneme (round-5 lever)
candidates.mechanism: Each phoneme in <prosody pitch="-2st" volume="-15%"> (the round-5 audition winner lever for isolated-phoneme scratch), break-after, no rate wrap. Drops the buzzy onset f0 the rate-slow over-articulated.

candidates.mechanism: Exact accepted letter-sounds shape: 300ms break BEFORE each phoneme, no whole-line rate wrap. Same break-before machinery the accepted letter-sounds tier uses, applied to PURE blend phonemes.

candidates.label: e — pitch-drop + volume-cut per phoneme (round-5 lever)
candidates.mechanism: Each phoneme in <prosody pitch="-2st" volume="-15%"> (the round-5 audition winner lever for isolated-phoneme scratch), break-after, no rate wrap. Drops the buzzy onset f0 the rate-slow over-articulated.

candidates.label: f — lightly-released stops (Dave top pick)
candidates.mechanism: STOPS (b/c/k/d/g/p/t) get a clipped <stop>ə release (inaudible as a syllable, NOT "kuh"); continuants + vowels stay bare. Break-after, no rate wrap. Listen: does the release stay sub-syllabic?
